## Install

Download **Mango-v1.0.0.apk** below and open it on your phone (allow installing unknown apps if Android asks). Android 8.0 or newer.

To update later, install the new APK over this one: your data stays.

**Coming from a test build (`app-debug.apk`)?** It was signed with a different key, so Android can't update it. Save a backup first (Options → Backup & restore → Save backup file), uninstall the old app, install this one, then choose *Restore a backup* on the welcome screen.

## Mango 1.0

Your climbing training, meals and groceries planned for you, on your phone, without internet.

**Training**
- Periodized program: Base, Max Strength, Power or Endurance, then Taper, as a fixed-length program or an endless 16-week cycle, with a deload every 4th week.
- Test days built in: max hang, weighted pull-up, pull-ups, dips, overhead press, push-ups and front lever, at the end of every deload week. The first week calibrates anything never tested.
- Loads, reps and holds follow your latest maxes from the day after a test; the Train tab shows your progress.
- Antagonist and shoulder health work every week; your equipment decides the exercises, with the closest alternative for anything missing.
- Guided timer that runs a whole session hands-free.

**Meals and groceries**
- Daily targets from your training phase; 163 recipes sized for one person, including French, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Southeast Asian classics.
- Zero-waste planning around your pantry and what expires first, batch cooking, fewer different items to buy, never the same dish two days in a row.
- Whole chicken: buy whole birds, break them down, turn the frame into stock, freeze the rest, with a kitchen prep card to guide you.
- Barcode pantry, spice rack, "Can't find it?" replacements, carb and meat choices.

**Your data**
- Everything stays on your phone: no account, no server, no tracking.
- Backup & restore to a file you choose, with optional auto-save.
